_source: Re-based onto environment/nanogpt_substrate.json for batch OER-2026-08-20, and re-derived from solution/grounding.yaml on 2026-09-06. Verifier-owned; never assembled onto the agent surface.
baseline_recipe: The mean, over every scheduled fold, of the degradation of the uniform allocation that assigns substrate.uniform_reference_bits to every quantizable tensor. That allocation saturates the bit budget exactly under the accounting in force, so it is the allocation a submission gets for spending the budget without reasoning about it.
per_point_bar_recipe: The baseline allocation's degradation at each scheduled fold, so the sustained-across-points invariant is held to a bar the harness itself reached at that fold.
reference_perplexity_recipe: The pristine checkpoint evaluated unquantized over the same folds in the same run, so both halves of the degradation come from one code path on one corpus.
statement: These scale points make the bound reward formula computable over this substrate. They are NOT published evidence, they do not close gap-oer-per-family-anchors-unmeasured, and they must not be read as a baseline_metric or a target_metric for family F9.
target_recipe: The mean, over every scheduled fold, of the degradation of the allocation the reference procedure at environment/model.py fit_allocation derives against the calibration version in force at the graded evaluation.
